preconditions.description: The number of intersections n must be between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a[i] <= n for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: Each shortcut a_i must be a valid intersection number between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: all(a[i] <= a[i + 1] for i in range(n - 1))

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly n integers.
Each output integer must be non-negative.
The energy required to reach intersection 1 must be 0.
